refresh_policy.notes: Treat SOCAT as an ocean-carbon observation catalog and download surface, not a single lightweight live API.

use_guidance.primary_role: Support ocean carbon sink saturation with official surface-ocean fCO2 observation access and carbon-cycle context.
use_guidance.caution: SOCAT is a curated observation program and download surface. It should strengthen ocean-carbon reasoning without implying one browser-live global sink metric.

overview.title: Surface Ocean CO2 Atlas
overview.description: SOCAT provides curated surface-ocean carbon dioxide observations widely used for air-sea CO2 flux and ocean carbon sink analysis.
